messages:
maya: Heads-up: scheduling a config-only change at 23:45 UTC. Targeting timeouts + routing tweak + batch window. Low-risk but want a short ops watch.

lior: on-call for 23:30-00:30, I can cover. what are the exact params?

maya: Patch summary: increase request_timeout_ms 2500->3500, cap per-tenant weight max 0.5->0.35, set routing_policy: prefer_durable, shorten batch_window_ms 100->60. Deploy plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% (15m checks).

tom: minor nit: shortening batch_window may increase compute churn. add metric: batch_size_avg and batch_count. Also watch queued_retries.

maya: good call. observability hooks added. deploy-bot dry-run in 10m.

deploy-bot: Dry-run started for patch=2026-04-config-timeout-route (pr=4221).

deploy-bot: Dry-run failed: schema error at routing_policy: "prefer_durable" not in enum [balanced, latency_first]. See validation error.

lior: hmm we added new enum; did we forget API registry bump?

maya: I pushed a quick validation fix to the platform registry. Will re-run dry-run.

deploy-bot: Dry-run successful. Canary plan created: steps=[10%,50%,100%], check_interval=15m. Rollout window=23:45-00:30 UTC.

maya: launching canary now. deploy-bot apply --patch=2026-04-config-timeout-route --mode=canary --start=23:45 --targets=global

deploy-bot: Apply started (run_id=20260410-09). Canary=10%. Est apply time ~30s.

tom: initial metrics: p95 flat, queued_retries +1, batch_size_avg down from 18->12 (expected).

lior: monitored tenant acme-corp shows spike in throttled_retries. p99 for that tenant +35%.

maya: interesting. only acme-corp? any pattern (region, model)?

lior: yes EU region, model=redwood-llama-7b, traffic spike correlated with their batcher config.

maya: decision: pause rollout at 10% and pin acme-corp to previous config to avoid customer impact. We can continue testing changes for others. Approve?

tom: ++ approve. we should avoid full rollback. manual pin is safer.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. Action: create tenant-exclude list: ["acme-corp"] while continuing canary for other tenants.

infra-bot: Manual action required: executing tenant pin for acme-corp -> config=previous (run_id=20260301-stable). Proceed?

maya: proceed with pin. Use runbook step 4 for manual pin command.

lior: running: `deploy-bot pin-tenant --tenant=acme-corp --config=20260301-stable --note="protect during config-only timeout/batch rollout"`

deploy-bot: Tenant pin applied for acme-corp. Confirmed exclusions: acme-corp. Canary continues for remaining traffic (10%).

tom: after pin, acme-corp p99 back to baseline in 2m. batch_size_avg stable for others.

maya: ok advance to 50% for non-excluded tenants. deploy-bot step?

deploy-bot: Advancing canary to 50% excluding pinned tenants. run_id=20260410-09.

lior: 50% applied. monitoring p95/p99, batch metrics, queued_retries. so far so good.

maya: roll to 100% excluding acme-corp. release notes draft: "config-only: increased request timeout to 3500ms, reduced tenant max weight to 0.35, routing policy added prefer_durable, batch window shortened to 60ms. Note: acme-corp temporarily pinned to previous config due to model-specific throttling; follow-up with SEs."

deploy-bot: Rollout complete for non-excluded tenants. run_id=20260410-09.

lior: filing follow-up issue to investigate acme-corp batcher interaction: #4350. Assigned to tom.

tom: got it. will sync with SEs and propose a gradual batch window cadence for that tenant.

maya: thanks all. tagging release-note and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
